label: Berlin History
lede: Berlin history told from places you can still stand in. Each one starts at a spot on my route or a street you already walk past, and explains what happened there, who decided it, and what is left to see.
shelfLegendSub: Grouped by the kind of ground it covers

lead.title: Berlin War Damage Still Visible: The Walls That Were Never Repaired
lead.excerpt: Berlin never patched most of what April 1945 did to its walls. The clearest place to start is a free, open courtyard on Museum Island, where bullet strikes sit in the colonnade stone at the height of a standing person. Here are seventeen places across the city where the marks are still there to find, how to tell what made each one, and which two need planning before you go.
